image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom automotive wheel mounted on a red vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a brushed silver finish and deep red inner barrels. The center cap displays a yellow shield logo resembling the Ferrari emblem. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing some wear and dirt on the sidewall. The brake caliper is visible through the spokes.
